_note: Per-compound conventions for Arm B, from what each calorimetry source states (Juno Phosphate-minerals, commit 670af88). Written 2026-10-24 before any crystal-field entropy of a phosphate was computed.

NdPO4.why: Popa 2006b: S298 'includes the Rln(2) contribution from the low temperature anomaly'. S(1000) none: its Cp equation states no valid range.

EuPO4.why: Ground 7F0 is a singlet, so the flag changes nothing.

GdPO4.why: Thiriet 2005 / Gurevich 2012: the antiferromagnetic transition entropy below 12 K is included in S298.

TbPO4.why: Only monoclinic (metastable) TbPO4 was measured (Gavrichev 2016); the frozen Tb levels are for tetragonal TbPO4.

DyPO4.why: No low-temperature calorimetry; Gysi 2016 is DSC above 348 K and its S298 is interpolated.

HoPO4.why: Tyurin 2020 includes the magnetic and Schottky entropy from 0.6 K (Cooke et al. below 9 K). S(T) above 298 K only in the supplement, not in hand.

ErPO4.why: Gavrichev 2012: functions are S(T) - S(2 K); the transition entropy below T_N about 0.4 K is 'unknown' and left out.

TmPO4.why: Ryumin 2017: S298 includes an assumed R ln 2 = 5.76 that its 1000 K table (S - S(10 K)) leaves out; added back so both points share the published convention. Ground level is a singlet, so the flag changes nothing. Also reported without the assumed 5.76 (variant), outside the verdict.

YbPO4.why: Gavrichev 2013: functions are S(T) - S(6.03 K); nothing stated below 6.03 K. Per the pre-registered handling a silent source is scored both ways and B1 uses the convention of the source measured furthest down, its own (from 6.03 K, so excluded).
